title: The Last Lamp Across the Saltglass

nodes.brief: Opening: the reader is a runner of the Ember-Lamp Post at Candlemere on the western rim of the dried Saltglass Basin; the town's harvest has failed and the elders hand over the Seedkey. The monsoon (the Return) will flood the basin in twenty days.

exits.intent: Ask the elders what they are not saying

nodes.brief: The reader takes the Seedkey straight from the elder's hand; describe the key (a cold ceramic key as long as a hand) and what it opens (the Rain Vault of Prism, the last drought-proof seed hall).

exits.intent: Go to pack for the road

nodes.brief: The reader questions the elders; they admit nobody has come back from Prism in twelve years and the Salt Court has been buying every well. Include the description of the Seedkey and the Rain Vault.

exits.intent: Go to pack for the road

nodes.brief: Packing at dawn at the Lamp-Post; the reader's family or friends see them off; the ember-lamp, a water skin and the Rim Road ahead.

exits.intent: Step out onto the Rim Road

nodes.brief: Arrival in Candlemere and the Rim Road: the lamp-town on the western rim, outfitting, rivals and kin, the first miles of the Rim Road; the reader hires help and takes the ember-lamp. The reader enters with several ways forward.

exits.intent: Ask the way of a stranger

nodes.brief: Mandatory scene at the Lamp-Post Gate: the reader decides whether to hire the glass-diver Pell, a wry guide who knows the Saltglass, or go alone

exits.intent: Hire Pell the glass-diver as guide
Go alone, trusting your own feet

nodes.brief: Mandatory scene at the Last Lamp-Stall: the reader decides whether to light the ember-lamp (it draws attention and warms the night) or carry it banked dark

exits.intent: Light the ember-lamp and carry it
Bank the lamp dark in its case to save oil

nodes.brief: Leaving Candlemere and the Rim Road for The Bitterflats: close this part of the journey.
A bad end in Candlemere and the Rim Road: the reader's gamble fails and the journey ends here (a death or ruin that is vivid but not gruesome).
A bad end in Candlemere and the Rim Road: the reader's gamble fails and the journey ends here (a death or ruin that is vivid but not gruesome).
Arrival in The Bitterflats: white salt flats, mirages, the Dune Sisters' wells and their oath, the Salt Court's toll-hut, rumours of the vault. The reader enters with several ways forward.

exits.intent: Ask the way of a stranger

nodes.brief: Mandatory scene at the Dune Sisters' Well: the Dune Sisters offer water in exchange for a binding oath (to answer one request later); the reader accepts or refuses

exits.intent: Swear the well-oath for water and shelter
Refuse the oath and pay dear for water

nodes.brief: Mandatory scene at the Toll-Hut: a Salt Court toll-hut: take their loan (a debt, with a creditor who will collect) or pay out of the reader's purse

exits.intent: Take the Salt Court's loan of passage
Pay the toll from your own purse

nodes.brief: Leaving The Bitterflats for The Shard Cities: close this part of the journey.

exits.intent: Believe the vault is still full

nodes.brief: Mandatory scene at the Glasswright Signal-Tower: a Glasswright offers to teach their mirror-signal speech in a night, at the cost of a day

exits.intent: Stay a night and learn the mirror-signals

Arrival in The Mirror Storm: a wall of glass-dust storm and the dune-sea beyond it; the lamp, the Seedkey and the body are all tested. The reader enters with several ways forward.

exits.intent: Ask the way of a stranger

nodes.brief: Mandatory scene at the Glass-Dust Wall: the storm wall rises; the reader decides how to protect the Seedkey (wrapped and slow, or quick and risky)

exits.intent: Wrap the Seedkey in cloth against the dust
Trust the pouch and run for it

nodes.brief: Mandatory scene at the Heart of the Storm: the storm threatens to smash the ember-lamp; the reader shields it (and is burned by glass) or lets it go dark

exits.intent: Shield the lamp with your own body
Let the storm take the lamp

nodes.brief: Mandatory scene at the Lens-Hall Door: the lens-hall maze; those with Pell have a guide who knows the Glasswright maintenance ways, those without must improvise

exits.intent: Pell knows the way through the lens-hall

Arrival in The Rain Vault: beneath Prism: the seed halls, the lock, every old promise coming due, and the final choice about the seed. The reader enters with several ways forward.

exits.intent: Ask the way of a stranger

nodes.brief: Mandatory scene at the Seed Halls: the seed halls; what the reader finds depends on whether they came believing the vault was full or looted

exits.intent: Walk the full halls you believed in
Search the looted halls for what was missed

nodes.brief: Mandatory scene at the Lock Chamber: the vault lock: sworn Dune Sisters know a well-song the lock remembers; others must work it by hand

exits.intent: Sing the Sisters' well-song to the lock

The reader has chosen to open the rain vault to everyone: the moment of carrying it out, with the consequences about to fall (do not decide which of the endings it is; the exits do that).
The reader has chosen to seal the vault and guard its secret: the moment of carrying it out, with the consequences about to fall (do not decide which of the endings it is; the exits do that).
The reader has chosen to take only the seed and run for candlemere: the moment of carrying it out, with the consequences about to fall (do not decide which of the endings it is; the exits do that).
Ending "The Seed Wakes": You open the Rain Vault to everyone: the key turns clean and the Sisters' well-song carries; the seed goes out along every road and Candlemere is fed.
Aftermath of "The Seed Wakes": what changes for the people of the Basin and Candlemere, weeks later.
Final page of "The Seed Wakes": a closing image and a last line for the book.

Ending "Opened, Unthanked": You open the vault to everyone and it works, but nobody sang for you and the Sisters and the Salt Court both claim the seed; you walk home with a clean key and a hard peace.
Aftermath of "Opened, Unthanked": what changes for the people of the Basin and Candlemere, weeks later.
Final page of "Opened, Unthanked": a closing image and a last line for the book.
Ending "The Door That Stuck": You open the vault, but the cracked key fails halfway; the door opens a hand's width and then freezes, and the seed spills out in a crush of hands.
Aftermath of "The Door That Stuck": what changes for the people of the Basin and Candlemere, weeks later.
Final page of "The Door That Stuck": a closing image and a last line for the book.
Ending "Pell Keeps the Door": You seal the Rain Vault to keep the seed safe; Pell stays as its keeper and you walk home lighter, with a friend's promise to wait.
Aftermath of "Pell Keeps the Door": what changes for the people of the Basin and Candlemere, weeks later.
Final page of "Pell Keeps the Door": a closing image and a last line for the book.
Ending "The Vault Remembers": You seal the vault alone and leave it to the glass; the seed is safe, but nobody remembers where the door is and the years go by.
Aftermath of "The Vault Remembers": what changes for the people of the Basin and Candlemere, weeks later.
Final page of "The Vault Remembers": a closing image and a last line for the book.
Ending "Clean Hands, Heavy Pack": You take only the seed and run for Candlemere, owing nobody; the road is long but yours, and the fields green at the rim.
Aftermath of "Clean Hands, Heavy Pack": what changes for the people of the Basin and Candlemere, weeks later.
Final page of "Clean Hands, Heavy Pack": a closing image and a last line for the book.
Ending "Light on the Road": You take the seed and run with the Salt Court's debt on your back; the ember-lamp still burns, and its light makes you a target and a beacon both.
Aftermath of "Light on the Road": what changes for the people of the Basin and Candlemere, weeks later.
Final page of "Light on the Road": a closing image and a last line for the book.
Ending "The Dark Walk Home": You take the seed and walk home in the dark with the Salt Court's debt behind you and no lamp; a long, quiet, uncertain return.
Aftermath of "The Dark Walk Home": what changes for the people of the Basin and Candlemere, weeks later.
Final page of "The Dark Walk Home": a closing image and a last line for the book.
